# @name: Foulgaze
# @zone: WizardCity/WC_Streets/WC_OldeTown
# @author: medicinals
# @format: bot
# @clients: == 1
# @description: Teleports to Sapphyra's Tower and farms the sigil.

# teleport to dungeon sigil
mass tp XYZ(-9677.087890625, -5201.8330078125, -2167.284423828125)
sleep 1
# pres X to enter sigil
sleep 1
mass sendkey X, 0.3
mass sendkey X, 0.3
# wait for zone change to dungeon
mass waitforzonechange completion
sleep 1
#walk all clients to  the mob
mass tp XYZ(470.28436279296875, -393.1438293457031, 0.007324219215661287)
sleep 1.0
# wait for combat to finish
mass waitforcombat completion
sleep 1.5
# walk all clients to the door
mass tp XYZ(36.91896057128906, -1209.098388671875, 1.620269775390625)
sleep 1
# wait for you to leave
mass waitforzonechange completion
sleep 2
name: Foulgaze
author: medicinals
